# Collion: Kai'Sa & ADC coaching

> Collion is one of only two Challenger Kai'Sa one-tricks: #1 Kai'Sa one-trick in the minor regions and #3 in the major regions on onetricks.gg, and #10 Kai'Sa on League of Graphs. He offers 1-on-1 League of Legends ADC and Kai'Sa coaching in English, live on Discord, for 25 EUR per hour (plus an optional 15 EUR data deep-dive of your recent ranked games).

## Coaching
- How a session goes: OP.GG pattern check, pick the games that show your weaknesses, full game review backed by statistics, you summarise and get a written bullet-point summary, optional live coaching.
- Focus: early laning phase, mid-game macro and teamfighting for ADC players. Kai'Sa players get champion-specific detail.
- Book: join https://discord.gg/yXxABBHcGC and DM `collion`.
